During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], small [[Yuuzhan Vong]] strike forces '''infiltrated''' the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant's]] [[Yaga Minor shipyards/Legends|shipyards]] at [[Yaga Minor/Legends|Yaga Minor]]. After flying a captured [[Sentinel-class landing craft/Legends|''Sentinel''-class landing shuttle]] into enemy [[Imperial Space|territory]], the Yuuzhan Vong [[Warrior caste|warriors]] located and sabotaged a reinforced [[munitions sphere]], the destruction of which they hoped would allow for a full Yuuzhan Vong invasion of the Remnant.

Before their withdrawal, the warriors discovered that a [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] in the [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] contained [[bafforr tree]] pollen, a substance that was [[Death/Legends|fatal]] to their [[Vonduun Skerr Kyrric|vonduun crab armor]]. Intending to destroy the lab, they stormed it but came across the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lady]] [[Lumiya]], who was hoping to steal the pollen for her own purposes. Lumiya survived the subsequent encounter.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|&hellip;if I don't have the fleet at home, the civil population will panic, and we are as good as lost if that happens.|[[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Pellaeon]] reflects on being recalled to Imperial Space after the Battle of Ithor|<ref name="Ruin">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin]]''</ref>}}
In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> during the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]'s [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] joined forces with the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] to [[Battle of Ithor|defend]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]] from the [[Yuuzhan Vong empire]].<ref name="Ruin" /> Following the battle, the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] left the front lines in order to safeguard its own [[Imperial Space|territory]].<ref name="IYZ" />

Yuuzhan Vong [[Warmaster]] [[Tsavong Lah]] was unwilling to be flanked by the New Republic on one side and the Remnant on the other. As such, he ordered small strike forces to infiltrate the Remnant's [[Yaga Minor shipyards/Legends|Yaga Minor shipyards]] and destroy their largest munitions dump, thus softening up the Imperials for a full-scale invasion.<ref name="IYZ" />

==The infiltration==
[[File:Dark_Lady_Lumiya.jpg|thumb|left|175px|The Sith Lady Lumiya was also infiltrating the shipyards.]]
In deep [[Realspace/Legends|space]], the [[Warrior caste|warriors]] of the strike forces set upon and captured a [[Sentinel-class landing craft/Legends|''Sentinel''-class landing shuttle]]. Disguising themselves with their [[ooglith masquer]]s, the team flew to [[Yaga Minor/Legends|Yaga Minor]] and penetrated its [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] defenses. They then located their target: a reinforced [[munitions sphere]].<ref name="IYZ" />

The Yuuzhan Vong warrior sabotaged the sphere and triggered an explosion, easily making their way through Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] as they escaped. Before reaching their [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], however, the [[Saboteur/Legends|saboteurs]] discovered that the [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] also contained a [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] where [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] were experimenting with the pollen of [[bafforr tree]]s.<ref name="IYZ" />

The pollen, native to Ithor, was [[Death/Legends|fatal]] to the Yuuzhan Vong's [[Vonduun Skerr Kyrric|vonduun crab armor]]. The warriors knew that the risk to their future invading forces was too great, and even though Yaga Minor's [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] were on full alert, they stormed the lab.<ref name="IYZ" />

Also at the lab were the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lady]] [[Lumiya]] and her escorts, who were hoping to steal the pollen for their own purposes.<ref name="IYZ" /> Lumiya survived her encounter with the Yuuzhan Vong warriors.<ref name="IYZ" /><ref name="Betrayal" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|They took us by surprise. We were holding our own to begin with. Then the Vong pulled back. We thought we had them on the run, but they were just getting out of the way. Once they'd punched a hole in our defenses, the Yuuzhan Vong came back into the fray. We've been on the back foot ever since.|Pellaeon, on the Yuuzhan Vong's attack on Bastion|<ref name="Remnant">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant]]''</ref>}}
The Yuuzhan Vong launched their invasion of Imperial space in [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]],<ref name="NEC" /> executing a [[Battle of Bastion|surprise attack]] on the Empire's [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]] of [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]]. The [[Battle of Borosk (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Battle of Borosk]] followed, and finally, a [[Battle of Yaga Minor (Yuuzhan Vong War)|battle]] at Yaga Minor. The latter engagement saw the Remnant [[Space warfare/Legends|chase]] the enemy out of Imperial space.<ref name="Remnant" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Assuming the heroes survive their encounter with the Sith Lord and her escorts, they must still escape through a wall of angry Star Destroyers and TIE fighters.|The adventure seed in "I, Yuuzhan Vong"|<ref name="IYZ" />}}
The Yuuzhan Vong's infiltration of the Yaga Minor shipyards is an adventure seed given to players in the article "[[I, Yuuzhan Vong]]," published in the [[Star Wars Gamer 8|eighth issue]] of ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' magazine. The article was written by [[Daniel Wallace]], and the issue was published on [[January 8]], [[2002]].<ref name="IYZ" />

The adventure seed mentions that the player characters may not necessarily survive their encounter with Lumiya in the laboratory, although if they do, they must escape through a screen of [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] and [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]].<ref name="IYZ" /> This [[Wookieepedia]] article makes no assumption as to the canonical outcome of the lab encounter beyond the survival of Lumiya, due to her appearances later in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] [[Timeline of Legends media|timeline]].<ref name="Betrayal" />
